definitions.explanation: Physically soft and bendable, or mentally adaptable and open to change. Used for both physical flexibility of the body or materials, and figurative flexibility in thinking, planning, or attitude.

examples.japanese: {柔軟|じゅうなん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧。
{柔軟|じゅうなん}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: A flexible way of thinking is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧{柔軟|じゅうなん}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is someone who can respond flexibly depending on the situation.

notes:
Na-adjective describing physical or mental flexibility.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {柔軟|じゅうなん}に
- Noun form: ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧さ (flexibility), ⟦{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}→柔軟性：05796_juunansei⟧ (flexibility as a quality)

CONJUGATION:
- Negative: {柔軟|じゅうなん}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧
- Te-form: {柔軟|じゅうなん}で
- Past: {柔軟|じゅうなん}だった

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}な⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧ (flexible thinking)
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (flexible attitude)
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}に⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to deal with flexibly)
- ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}{体操|たいそう}→柔軟体操：25010_juunantaisou⟧ (stretching exercises)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧: soft to the touch, gentle — focuses on physical texture
- ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧: flexible, adaptable — emphasizes ability to bend or adjust
